thread:
alexa_partnerships: FYI — BrightWay Analytics AWS Marketplace onboarding is blocked. Their procurement is refusing to sign our standard PO until AWS confirms merchant account mapping. AWS says merchant ID needs to match the EIN on the PO. Customer won't share EIN until legal signs a redlined MSA. Looping folks. :grimacing:

nick_deals: Ugh. Can you paste the PO + which clause is being redlined? I can ping AWS PM if we have specifics.

alexa_partnerships: Order ref: BW-2026-0421. PO XML snippet they sent: 
```xml
<PurchaseOrder id="BW-2026-0421">
  <Buyer>EIN: 12-3456789</Buyer>
  <Seller>Redwood Inference</Seller>
</PurchaseOrder>
```
They attached a signed redline that changes Section 8 (indemnity) and requires a counter-signature from our legal. They've withheld EIN until legal approves the redline — procurement policy.

ops-bot: Ticket created: PARTNERS-11234 — "BrightWay AWS merchant/EIN mismatch + MSA redline". Assigned: partnerships, legal, finance. https://tickets.internal/PARTNERS-11234

sanjay_legal: Can you upload the redline PDF? If it's only indemnity tweaks we may be able to accept limited language. I can triage but need the exact diff to advise. @alexa_partnerships

alexa_partnerships: Uploaded to the thread (link): https://files.internal/bw-redline-0421.pdf — main ask is carveouts for third-party data processors and locale-specific liability cap.

emily_finance: From finance side — we can't map AWS merchant ID to invoices until we have EIN on the PO. We can do provisional bookkeeping but legal needs to greenlight first. If procurement sends certified EIN attestation (signed by company officer) that could unblock temporarily.

nick_deals: AWS PM, can you confirm how strict their merchant-EIN validation is? Is there a manual override on their side for marketplace listings? @aws-pm

aws-pm: AWS can do a manual merchant mapping in exceptional cases but they require either (a) notarized EIN verification or (b) signed MSA with matching legal entity. They'll only accept case (a) with partner ops approval. I can attempt to get partner ops to accept a provisional attestation while legal triages the redline.

ravi_engineering: If we get a provisional greenlight from AWS/purchasing, how long to stand up the BrightWay sandbox listing and initial integration? We can have a basic listing + test SKU live in ~48 hours.

alexa_partnerships: Great — that's helpful. Two asks: 1) @sanjay_legal please review redline and propose a 1-paragraph counter that keeps our indemnity posture but addresses their processor carveout. 2) @emily_finance can you confirm whether a signed EIN attestation (PDF with officer signature) is enough for Redwood to bill temporarily?

sanjay_legal: I'll take a pass now. If it's small, I can approve a limited counter by EOD PST. If they insist on broad indemnity carveouts, we'll need a short escalated approval from GC.

emily_finance: A signed EIN attestation gets us partway, but for AWS merchant mapping we need either the EIN on the PO or a notary. We can accept the attestation to start internal billing, but AWS partner ops is stricter.

nick_deals: Plan B if legal needs >48h: Ask BrightWay to sign our unmodified PO for the initial pilot (lower risk) and keep the redline active for their enterprise procurement for later phases. Would they consider that?

alexa_partnerships: BrightWay says procurement policy forbids signing anything without merchant mapping. They will ask for a Pro Forma invoice instead — which AWS won't accept for merchant mapping.

ops-bot: Reminder: meeting scheduled with BrightWay procurement 2026-04-22 10:00 PDT (calendar invite sent).

sanjay_legal: Draft counter completed — two small edits, preserves our indemnity. Uploading now. If they accept, ask AWS PM to do manual merchant mapping against the signed MSA + PO.

alexa_partnerships: Uploaded. Sent to BrightWay under cover email: "legal counter + request for signed EIN attestation". Waiting on their reply.

aws-pm: I can escalate to partner-ops for a manual mapping if BrightWay returns the signed counter + EIN attestation. I'll queue it as high priority once we have both.

emily_finance: Noted. If we get the attestation + signed counter I will prepare internal invoice mapping and flag for accelerated settlement.

nick_deals: Thanks everyone. I'll join the 10am call and push AWS PM to prioritize partner-ops.

alexa_partnerships: Closing loop for now — next update after procurement call. If anyone sees vendor-side docs come in, drop them in this thread. :eyes: :pray:
